description.value: Cadeaux Bakery is a specialty bakery situated in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, known for handcrafted pastries—butter croissants, double-baked almond croissants, fruit danishes, and savoury scones—alongside an extensive menu of made-to-order custom cakes. The compact Powell Street storefront is wheelchair accessible and operates as a walk-in shop, making it a practical calorie stop for cyclists riding through the eastern edge of downtown Vancouver. The bakery does not offer gluten-free or vegan cake options at this time.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the bakery's address (172 Powell Street, Vancouver BC V6A 1G1), phone number (604-608-8889), and active operation under the same name; all three match OSM tags exactly. No cycling-specific amenities—bike parking, water refill, washrooms, racks, charging—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags (OSM wheelchair=yes is noted but not cycling-relevant). The bakery sells freshly baked pastries and made-to-order cakes, with the FAQ confirming walk-in is possible ('come into our shop'), though online orders carry a 6-piece minimum with 48-hour notice.
concerns: Category 'Groceries' is a loose fit—this is a specialty pastry and custom-cake shop, not a general grocery store.
Online pastry orders require a 6-piece minimum with 48-hour advance notice; walk-in availability of individual items is implied by the FAQ but not explicitly confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active specialty bakery in Gastown with confirmed details and walk-in access; freshly baked pastries and savoury items make it a viable calorie resupply stop for touring cyclists on the Powell Street corridor.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery was mapped to 'Groceries', but this is a specialty pastry and custom-cake bakery, not a general grocery store. A 'Bakery' or 'Food' sub-category would be more accurate.
